completed_steps: Audited multi-tenancy & organizationId filtering across API routes (patients, appointments, publicBooking, invoices, billing, cashbox, warehouse)
Audited slot booking concurrency & race conditions (double-booking hierarchy locking Level 1-4, advisory locks, exclusion constraints 23P01)
Audited warehouse deduction & fiscalization concurrency (advisory xact locks, FOR UPDATE, FEFO batch allocations, Mandate 8ab soft negative stock)
Audited Mandate 8n chairside resilience (zero fatal 500s on out-of-stock, unblocked emergency override under Art. 124 UK RF)
Audited fail-closed FORCE RLS integration with withTenantCtx in billingQuery.ts and test fixtures
Executed targeted tests via node --import tsx --test across 9 suites (37/37 tests passed)
Submitted comprehensive verbatim report to parent orchestrator

findings.details: All audited routes enforce requireResolvedOrganizationId / requireClinicalContext using verified JWT tokens, preventing raw x-organization-id spoofing. PostgreSQL FORCE RLS is fail-closed.
Hierarchy locking (Level 1 Chairs -> Level 2 Staff -> Level 3 Patients -> Level 4 Row) strictly prevents deadlocks (40P01) and concurrent double-booking. Conflict returns 409 Conflict.

pg_advisory_xact_lock on clientMutationId, FOR UPDATE on locked patient, and database unique constraint payments_org_client_mutation_unique prevent double-charges and double-fiscalization on rapid double-clicks. Patched createPaymentInDb with withTenantCtx.

FEFO batch deduction locks rows FOR UPDATE and supports soft overdraft (emergency_overdraft ledger). Stock shortage at chairside never throws fatal 400/500 or blocks medical care; returns 200 OK with soft overdraft notice.
